note: USFS Lolo NF in the Ninemile drainage, ~5 mi past the Ninemile Ranger Station (Remount Rd, then the Edith Peak and Butler Creek Loop roads), around 7-acre Kreis Pond: shore fishing for stocked westslope cutthroat, paddling from the shoreline, and easy multi-use trails popular for mountain biking. Day-use area with grills. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Sept 15, 2026) confirms $10 (cash/check), 7 sites, vault toilets, no potable water; added FCFS/no reservations, a two-night camping limit, and season April 1 - December 1 (was only 'not year-round'). 35-ft max RV (derived) not on the page, left. No alert for the campground or its roads.
